target.name: Methyl ester, from biogenic oils, mix, at regional storage

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tab. 2.6, column 'methyl ester, from biogenic oils, mix, at regional storage' [RER], per 1 kg of that product; the column entries are mass shares in %; allocation: none stated; the table is a market mix, the shares are the 2016 biomass feedstock shares for Europe (column 'Shares biomass feedstock RER 2016'). Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: The six shares in the methyl ester column add up to 99 %, not 100 % — the excerpt gives no line for the missing 1 %.

All other rows of Tab. 2.6 (heat from natural gas, electricity, ethanol fermentation plant, sewage treatment, the ethanol feedstocks and the waste heat emission) carry a value only in the 'ethanol, 99.7% in H2O, from biomass, at distillation' column and a 0 in the methyl ester column, so no energy, infrastructure or direct emission is documented for this dataset.
No transport to the regional storage is given in the excerpt although the dataset name says 'at regional storage'.
